cohort_rule: Paper IDs successfully coded by the reference model
irr_rule: One balanced paper-ID intersection shared by every displayed model
supplementary_irr_rule: Llama 3.2 enters the displayed IRR cohort only when its usable analytical export contains at least 21,930 unique corpus papers
cross_model_agreement_rule: Paper-level agreement uses every available assignment from Mini, Nano, Claude, Gemini, and Llama; missing Llama papers remain explicitly unavailable rather than being treated as agreement or disagreement
